title: Positive Change for Sailors
official: Evaluating Positive Change for Sailors: A Web-based Sexual Assault Prevention Program
summary: Alcohol use and sexual violence are significant public health issues affecting military personnel. This study includes a pilot randomized control trial of Positive Change© for Sailors, an integrated alcohol and sexual assault prevention program tailored to U.S. Navy personnel. Active duty Sailors aged 18-24 will be randomized to receive Positive Change© for Sailors or an assessment-only control condition. Analyses will be conducted to assess feasibility and examine preliminary differences in behavior, perceived norms, and related attitudes immediately following the program and at a three month follow-up assessment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Active duty
* Navy service branch
* Enlisted rank
* Ages 18-24

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not active duty
* Serving in a military branch other than the Navy
* Not of enlisted rank (e.g., Commissioned officer, Warrant officer)
* Under 18 years of age
* Over 24 years of age
